evidence.relevance: Item text in the release documentation.
evidence.quote: next-image-experimental: After running the previous codemod, you can optionally run this experimental codemod to upgrade next/legacy/image to the new next/image, which will remove unused props and add inline styles.

context_facts.why_not_risk: The item describes an optional, experimental codemod (next-image-experimental) that upgrades next/legacy/image to the new next/image. It is a migration aid, not a breaking change, and running it is not required. The stated limitation, that it covers only static usage and not dynamic usage such as <Image {...props} />, affects only users who choose to run it. The behavior change to next/image itself is a separate item, and the text says the first codemod keeps the Next.js 12 behavior.
